notes.title: 👀 First Look: Steam Early Access! 🎉
notes.content: [h3][b]Avakins, the wait is over — Avakin Life has officially launched in Steam Early Access![/b][/h3][p]This is your chance to experience the game like never before on PC. 💜[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502296/dc1565b99f784c5e8d6e781e3e10df5ebeb3a538.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🎁 Community Rewards:[/b][/h3][p]Milestone rewards are still waiting to be unlocked, and with every wishlist, we get closer to unlocking even more surprises for everyone 🚀[/p][p][/p][p]📥 Haven’t wishlisted yet? Add Avakin Life to your Steam wishlist today and join the journey![/p][p][/p][p]💬 Already playing? We’d love to hear from you — leave us a review on Steam and help us shape the future of Avakin Life on PC.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Stay tuned for upcoming events, announcements, and exclusive surprises.[/p][p][/p][p]💜 Let’s make this Early Access launch unforgettable — together![/p]

notes.title: 2.11.0 Patch update!
notes.content: [p]Good news, Avakins! 🎉[/p][p]We’ve fixed the loading screen issue that was causing some players to get stuck at 60%.[/p][p]You can now jump back in, explore, and enjoy Avakin Life without delays. Thank you so much for your patience while we worked to get you back in the game![/p][p]We hear you and 💖 your feedback! Every comment helps us improve Avakin Life, so keep sharing your thoughts and ideas![/p]

notes.title: 💥 40K Wishlists Reached! 💥
notes.content: [h3][b]We’ve hit another huge milestone — 40,000 wishlists! 🎉[/b][/h3][p]That means the [b]Desktop Set reward[/b] is on its way to everyone. 🖥✨ Perfect for adding a little extra flair to your space.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502296/4fd842cb5c84f05f8da5962788a441523107fc27.png"][/img][/p][p]But the journey’s not over yet…[/p][p][/p][p]The next milestone is [b]50K wishlists[/b], and the reward?[/p][p][/p][p][b]🏅 A special in-game badge to show you were part of this milestone moment.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Let’s keep the momentum going — more wishlists = more rewards and surprises ahead. 🚀[/p][p]Thank you all for your incredible support. 💚[/p]

notes.title: 🎭 Your First Look in Avakin Life – Early Access is Here! 🎭
notes.content: [h3][b]Early Access has landed, and Avakin Life is ready for its big PC debut! 🔥[/b][/h3][p]We’re inviting you to share your first in-game look and show the community how you’re styling up this exciting moment.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502296/04db0641c6301c4a9ef214b5cf60342a348a2def.png"][/img][/p][p]Whether you’re going for [i]bold streetwear, cozy gamer vibes, or full cyberpunk flair,[/i] this is your time to shine. 🖤[/p][p][/p][p]Some of our favorite styles will be featured in upcoming highlights for the launch.[/p][p][/p][p]📌 Join the conversation and see what others are creating on our official Discord. You may also share your style here on STEAM with screenshots to be added in artwork![/p][p][/p][p]📥 Haven’t added Avakin Life to your wishlist yet? Now’s the perfect time — help us reach our next milestone and unlock more for the whole community.[/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Avakin Life is NOW live on Steam Early Access! 🎉
notes.content: [h3]The world of Avakin just got bigger! Jump into the PC version and start your next adventure today![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502296/ae4d6e2ccdecdd4ee8e0ccaedc53d28bd1d29f31.png"][/img][/p][p]🔥 Ready to meet new friends, style up, and explore? The fun’s waiting for you![/p][p][/p][p]🎮 Don’t forget to wishlist if you haven’t already to stay in the loop on all updates and events.[/p][p][/p][p]Drop a like if you’re hyped to play! 🙌[/p][p][/p][h2][b]👉 PLAY AVAKIN LIFE NOW on Steam![/b][/h2]

notes.title: Avakin Life: Steam Early Access Launches August 13!
notes.content: [h2][b]The wait is almost over![/b][/h2][h3]We’re excited to announce that [b]Avakin Life[/b] will officially launch in Steam Early Access on [b]August 13.[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502296/24efb9675b6aa447bf4a1fba97f801c1b3951f33.png"][/img][/p][h3][i]Here’s what you can look forward to on PC:[/i][/h3][list][*][p]Some scenes with PC movement support for seamless exploration[/p][/*][*][p]Special launch events and community activities[/p][/*][*][p]Guest appearances from creators[/p][/*][*][p]Surprise giveaways to celebrate this milestone with our players[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]But that’s not all.[/p][p]We’re still aiming to reach our next wishlist milestone, and every new milestone unlocks mystery community rewards for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t added Avakin Life to your Steam wishlist yet, now is the time.[/p][p][/p][p]Your support brings us closer to unlocking more for the entire community.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]👉 Add Avakin Life to your Steam Wishlist today and be ready for launch![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][i]Stay tuned for more announcements and upcoming events as we prepare to welcome you into Avakin Life on PC.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Creating the Ultimate Cozy Paradise in Avakin Life on PC
notes.content: [h3][i]Marissa just moved into Avakin Life on PC, started decorating… and it already feels like home. [/i]🏠[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502296/09582240c0026bc59584eb0f15a4e333a49465b2.png"][/img][/p][p]She’s turning her space into the ultimate cozy corner, and it’s giving soft vibes only.[/p][p][/p][p]With the incoming Avakin Life Early Access, you can customize, decorate, and relax in a fully immersive Avakin experience — bigger, smoother, and built for your aesthetic.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’re dreaming of your own cozy corner, now’s the perfect time to jump in.[/p][p][/p][h3]👉 Wishlist Avakin Life on Steam and get ready to create your perfect vibe.[/h3][p][/p][p][i]This is just the beginning. Your cozy paradise awaits.[/i][/p]
